investment_theses.thesis: Anthropic IPO is a capital drain on AI infrastructure capex cycle; NVIDIA and other AI chip stocks face earnings miss risk as AI model glut intensifies competition and capex/training ROI deteriorates through H2 2026.
supporting_signals: CNBC: Anthropic raised record $93.5B in IPO, signaling mature market consolidation, not growth.
CNBC: 'Nvidia crisis' cited as obstacle Anthropic overcame; Asian tech shares sliding.
CoinDesk: BTC down three days, volatility surging; risk-off sentiment reducing speculative AI M&A appetite.
Cathie Wood's ARK buying Anthropic signals peak AI hype cycle rotation (buying IPO winners, not infrastructure).
investment_theses.counter_view: AI infrastructure remains undersupplied; enterprise LLM deployment accelerating; Anthropic IPO success proves investor appetite for AI, raising odds of further chipmaker capex guidance raises.
investment_theses.expression: Short NVDA via puts (90-day, 10-15% OTM); or underweight semiconductor ETF (SMH) vs. broad market (SPY long).

investment_theses.thesis: U.S.-China trade tensions will escalate to explicit AI semiconductor tariffs by Q3 2026; this creates short-term chip stock pressure but long-term reshoring and onshore AI capex boost for domestic players.
supporting_signals: CNBC: Trump returns from Asia with 'few concrete outcomes'; Taiwan tech tensions remain 'unresolved.'
CNBC: U.S.-China trade remains contentious focal point for Trump administration.
BBC: Russia-Ukraine escalation increases NATO/U.S. tech security focus on domestic chip supply.
No prediction market yet betting on AI semiconductor tariff probability; market consensus underweights policy risk.
investment_theses.counter_view: Trump may prioritize deal-making over tariffs; China retaliatory tariffs on U.S. tech exports risk; Anthropic/AI sector lobbying could soften tariff stance.
investment_theses.expression: Long domestic semiconductor exposure (Micron MU, Marvell MRVL) vs. short global exposure (TSMC via calls); or long Semiconductor ETF (SMH) overweighting U.S. names; express via outperformance trade (MU/NVDA ratio).

investment_theses.thesis: ECB and European regulators will fast-track tokenized asset framework by year-end 2026 to prevent capital flight; this creates regulatory clarity premium for Coinbase and European crypto infrastructure players.
supporting_signals: CoinDesk/Cointelegraph: Lagarde warns Europe 'could lose control' of tokenized markets; policy urgency evident.
CoinDesk: ECB Largarde tokenization warning signals potential coordinated easing or regulatory push.
Cathie Wood ARK massive Anthropic IPO buy signals institutional capital rotation into regulated AI/crypto infrastructure.
CFTC clarity on onchain trading (no special rules for Hyperliquid) gives regulatory roadmap.
investment_theses.counter_view: EU regulatory process is slow; tokenization remains niche; EU capital controls and fragmentation could persist; U.S. regulatory dominance may undercut EU framework adoption.
investment_theses.expression: Long Coinbase (COIN) calls (6-month, 10-15% OTM) on ECB regulatory clarity; or long crypto ETFs with EU custody focus (if available); or bet on EUR outperformance vs. USD if ECB pro-crypto pivot signals easing (EUR/USD long).
